operation.summary: OAuth protected resource metadata for MCP

operation.description:
Requires database reachability and a compatible applied schema version.
Returns no hostnames, credential details, SQL errors or internals.

operation.summary: MCP session listen is not offered

405.description: Method not allowed. No session is created.

operation.description:
Bearer access token only. X-FAD-API-Key is not accepted. The route
exists only when MCP is enabled and an external issuer is configured.
GET and DELETE do not create a session.

operation.summary: MCP session close is not offered

405.description: Method not allowed. No session is created.

operation.summary: List agents in the authenticated organization
operation.description:
Requires agents:read. Ordered by created_at descending, then id
descending. limit defaults to 25 and cannot exceed 100. Unknown query
parameters return 400 VALIDATION_ERROR.

operation.summary: Register an agent in the authenticated organization
operation.description:
Requires agents:write and Idempotency-Key. The server chooses the agent
id, global_id, status, revision, and audit identity. organization_id in
the body is rejected. An identical replay returns 201 and the same agent.

operation.summary: Search agents by exact typed tag equality
operation.description:
Read-only. Requires agents:read. Tag predicates also require tags:read.
A restricted predicate requires tags:restricted:read before any agent
query runs. Predicates use AND. At most 8 predicates. The agent
response shape is the Slice 1 list.

Requires agents:read. A missing agent and an agent in another
organization both return 404 AGENT_NOT_FOUND.

operation.summary: Update agent name, description, or owner
operation.description:
Requires agents:write, Idempotency-Key, and a strong If-Match value.
The body is a partial document. Only supplied fields change.
description null clears the description. status cannot be changed here.
A retired agent cannot be edited. A no-op keeps the revision.

Requires agents:lifecycle. Active to active is a no-op. Retired is
terminal and returns 409.
Requires agents:read and capabilities:read. Tombstones are omitted. At most 32 live bindings.
Requires agents:read and capabilities:read. A missing or tombstoned binding returns 404.

operation.summary: Bind one capability version to one endpoint
operation.description:
Requires capabilities:write, Idempotency-Key, and exactly one of
If-None-Match * or If-Match cap-binding-vN. The version must exist in
the caller organization. The endpoint must belong to this agent and
be enabled. One live version per capability id.
Requires capabilities:write, Idempotency-Key, and If-Match cap-binding-vN. The row stays.
Requires agents:read and endpoints:read. Tombstones are omitted. The directory does not contact the URL.
Requires agents:read and endpoints:read. A missing or tombstoned endpoint returns 404.

Requires endpoints:write, Idempotency-Key, and exactly one of
If-None-Match * or If-Match endpoint-vN. The URL is stored and is not
resolved or called. A retired agent returns 409. At most eight live
endpoints are allowed.

operation.summary: Tombstone an endpoint that has no live binding
operation.description:
Requires endpoints:write, Idempotency-Key, and If-Match endpoint-vN.
A live binding returns 409. The row stays and the revision increases.

Requires agents:lifecycle. Retired to retired is a no-op. A retired
agent stays readable and cannot be activated or patched.

Requires agents:lifecycle. Suspended to suspended is a no-op and does
not increase the revision. Retired to suspended returns 409.

Requires agents:read and tags:read. Restricted assignments are omitted
unless the caller has tags:restricted:read. Tombstones are omitted.
An agent outside the caller organization is the same 404 as a missing agent.

Requires agents:read and tags:read. A restricted assignment without
tags:restricted:read is the same 404 as a missing assignment.
The ETag is tag-vN and does not change the agent ETag.

operation.summary: Assign or replace one tag value
operation.description:
Requires tags:write. A governed or restricted tag also requires
tags:governance. Send exactly one of If-None-Match * or a strong
If-Match tag-vN. Idempotency-Key is required. A governed change
requires reason. false and 0 are valid values. This does not change
the agent revision.

Requires tags:write and a strong If-Match. A governed tag also requires
tags:governance and X-Change-Reason. The row stays. The revision
increases. There is no response body.

operation.summary: List capability versions in the caller organization
operation.description:
Requires capabilities:read. Order is capability id ascending, then
version ascending as text, not semantic version order.

Requires capabilities:write. The organization comes from the credential.
The version cannot be changed or deleted. verification is self_declared.
The same Idempotency-Key and body returns the original 201. A new key
for an existing version returns 409.
Requires capabilities:read. Another organization and a missing version both return 404.

operation.summary: Find active agents in the caller organization
operation.description:
Requires agents:read, capabilities:read, and endpoints:read. Tag
predicates also require tags:read. A restricted predicate also
requires tags:restricted:read. The query stays in the caller
organization. The directory does not call declared endpoints.
A match is not a health, trust, or invocation decision.
Idempotency-Key is ignored.

operation.summary: Return organization bound to caller's verified API key
operation.description:
Requires organizations:read. The caller cannot select an organization
using a header, query parameter, or body. Unknown query parameters
return 400 VALIDATION_ERROR.

Requires tags:read. Restricted definitions are omitted unless the
caller also has tags:restricted:read. The page does not report a count
of omitted definitions.

200.description: Visible definitions in namespace and key order

operation.summary: Create an immutable typed tag definition
operation.description:
Requires tags:define. A governed or restricted definition also requires
tags:governance. Reserved namespaces security, compliance, and system
must be governed and restricted. The definition cannot be changed later.

Requires tags:read. A restricted definition without
tags:restricted:read is the same 404 as a missing definition.
